as_told.title: Epstein emails about killing Pons-Fleischmann cold fusion

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that among the released emails of the financier Jeffrey Epstein is one where Epstein brags that he "killed Pons" years earlier. Michels takes this to mean Stanley Pons, who with Martin Fleischmann claimed in 1989 to have achieved cold fusion, a cheap form of nuclear energy at room temperature. In one telling he adds, citing the writer Whitney Webb, that Epstein sold software tied to Sandia, a US nuclear weapons laboratory, that siphoned nuclear secrets, and he raises it because it would suggest powerful people worked to bury a possible energy breakthrough.
